HCBCOGN312.contribution: Experimental language acquisition, bilingualism, reading and dyslexia contribute directly to language development and learning.
HCBCOGN312.topics: Psycholinguistics is the study of the neurobiological and psychological factors that enable us to acquire, use, and understand language. Modern research draws on cognitive psychology, neuroscience, and computer science to investigate how language is processed. The course focuses primarily, though not exclusively, on the neuroscience of language. Students examine theoretical and experimental issues in speech production and comprehension, language impairments, the relationship between thought and language, and the evolution and acquisition of language. They also gain hands-on experience with experimental approaches to the study of language and develop an understanding of human linguistic capacity as a subject of multidisciplinary research. Topics covered: What is language? Evolutionary aspects of language and animal communication; language and thought; aphasia; language acquisition; bilingualism; speech comprehension; semantics; reading and dyslexia; speech production.

candidateAssessment.concept: Child Development, Education and Social Research
candidateAssessment.assessment: Developmental psychology provides attachment, childhood and play, while Psycholinguistics supplies language acquisition, bilingualism and reading. Youth Resilience directly develops school-climate and youth-support work. Rhetoric in Action includes age-appropriate coaching with a primary-school partner. Public economics, education inequality and public-policy methods strengthen the contextual analysis. The trial still lacks a sustained pedagogical inquiry into parenting, family support, educational design and evaluation, and their interaction with child development.

Psychodiagnostics and Psychotherapies supplies interviews, measurement, family therapy and a child/adolescent strand. Psychopathology covers developmental disorders within a broad clinical survey. Youth support, development, experimental methods and health add substance. The resulting trial centres on psychology, without a cumulative sequence in educational and developmental needs assessment, pedagogy and interventions in child and school settings.

The school project, language acquisition, rhetoric and child development contribute genuine teaching and learning content. The combined teacher direction does not support a coherent sequence of subject didactics, curriculum design and supervised classroom practice. This is a substantive difference beyond teaching credentials.

academicFinding: UCR offers child development, language acquisition, research methods and practical school-based work. These contribute to understanding how children learn and develop. The feasible UCR schedules do not develop upbringing, family support, educational design and evaluation into a sustained programme of study. These subjects bring together the psychology, research and practice in the Groningen degree.
